column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-activities - multi-type table, discriminated by itemType. Every content item carries a groupId so feeds stay isolated per household. Each grid below is one itemType.

column2: A like on an activity comment (separate item)
A like on a request comment (separate item)
The group's singleton active Spotify Jam

column1: activity - no itemType. updatedAt absent on legacy rows falls back to createdAt in API projections; liveStartedAt is set only while the activity is live.
checklist - itemType "checklist". Archived checklists are hidden from the active feed.
request - itemType "request". responses maps an account id to yes / no / maybe; targets not yet answered are absent.

comment likes - itemType "commentLike" or "requestCommentLike". Stored as their own small items so a like is a single conditional write. id is deterministic: parentId:commentId:userId. A commentLike sets activityId; a requestCommentLike sets requestId.
spotifyJam - itemType "spotifyJam". One singleton item per group; ending the Jam deletes the item, so absent means no active Spotify module. updatedAt equals createdAt for the singleton replacement.
